blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bella Belen unleashed another well-rounded game, pouring in 29 points to complete another Capital1 comeback against ZUS Coffee, 20-25, 25-17, 22-25, 25-20, 15-8, in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Mall of Asia Arena. Fresh off a 35-point career-high, Belen delivered 25 kills and four blocks and defended the floor with 16 digs and 15 excellent receptions as the Solar Spikers improved to 2-1 despite playing in their third consecutive fifth-set game.
